Score each supplied baseline measurement for its expected predictive usefulness for this task using only the measurement descriptions and task description (no patient records or labels). Assign each field ID a floating-point relevance score in [0.0, 1.0] (1.0 = most useful, 0.0 = irrelevant). Return strict JSON with the single top-level key "scores" mapping every supplied field ID to its numeric score.
{"task": "Assess mechanical bowel obstruction and local surgical complexity in this colon cancer case.", "fields": {"F4": {"description": "Perforation of the colon", "name": "perfor"}, "F0": {"description": "Assigned adjuvant treatment regimen", "name": "rx"}, "F7": {"description": "Histologic tumour differentiation grade", "name": "differ"}, "F9": {"description": "Time from surgery to registration, short or long", "name": "surg"}, "F3": {"description": "Obstruction of the colon by tumour", "name": "obstruct"}, "F6": {"description": "Number of lymph nodes with detectable cancer", "name": "nodes"}, "F1": {"description": "Recorded sex", "name": "sex"}, "F2": {"description": "Age in years", "name": "age"}, "F5": {"description": "Adherence to nearby organs", "name": "adhere"}, "F8": {"description": "Local extent of tumour spread", "name": "extent"}}}
